description: Source code for Llama Guard class implementing content moderation with safety checks, prompt template setup, and moderation hook using litellm library.

classes.name: _ENTERPRISE_LlamaGuard
classes.description: A class extending CustomLogger to perform content safety moderation using LlamaGuard model, including prompt setup and async moderation hook.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the LlamaGuard, loads unsafe content categories from a file, and sets the model.

methods.name: print_verbose
methods.description: Logs verbose messages and optionally prints them if verbose mode is enabled.

methods.name: set_custom_prompt_template
methods.description: Sets up a custom prompt template for safety checking based on conversation messages.

methods.name: async_moderation_hook
methods.description: Performs an asynchronous safety moderation check on the last message using the LlamaGuard model and raises HTTPException if content is unsafe.
